productsPage.eyebrow: Direct From Indian Farms to Global Ports
productsPage.intro: Each product in our catalogue is sourced directly from vetted farming collectives across India. Meticulously sorted, graded for export caliber, and safeguarded with unbroken cold-chain logistics to deliver peak freshness to our international partners.

cta.title: Require Custom Bulk Packaging or Private Labelling?
cta.text: We cater to customized palletized shipments, CIF / FOB contracts, and dedicated branding boxes for international wholesalers and retail chains across the Middle East, Europe, and Asia.

banana.name: G9 Cavendish Green Banana
banana.subtitle: Naturally Grown • Flawless Caliber • Farm-Fresh Export Grade
banana.description: Cultivated across India's fertile river basins under ideal tropical sunlight, our G9 (Grand Nain) Cavendish green bananas are internationally acclaimed for their thick protective peel, uniform finger length, and rich creamy taste upon ripening. Procured directly from GlobalGAP certified orchards, each hand is gently washed, sanitized, calibrated, and packed in pristine food-grade vacuum bags to guarantee optimum shelf life during marine voyage.

specs.label: Packaging
specs.value: 7 kg / 13 kg Box, as per your requirement

chilli.name: G4 Fresh Green Chilli
chilli.subtitle: Pungent & Vibrant • High Capsaicin • Hand-Harvested Daily
chilli.description: Our G4 export green chillies are celebrated globally for their intense natural pungency, radiant glossy green sheen, and crispy texture. Harvested in the early morning dew to retain maximum moisture and essential capsaicin oils, each pod undergoes stringent optical and manual grading to eliminate blemishes, ensuring only uniform, long-stemmed chillies reach our state-of-the-art cold-pack facility.

specs.label: Packaging
specs.value: 3.5 kg / 4 kg / 5 kg Box, as per your requirement

pom.name: Bhagwa Premium Pomegranate
pom.subtitle: Ruby-Red Arils • High Brix Sweetness • Superfruit Antioxidants
pom.description: Renowned as the crown jewel of Indian horticulture, the Bhagwa pomegranate is globally coveted for its glowing saffron-red rind and tender, seedless ruby-red arils dripping with sweet, antioxidant-dense juice. Sourced straight from Solapur—India's pomegranate capital—every fruit is carefully weighed, foam-sleeved, and nested to guard its delicate crown and ruby luster across thousands of nautical miles.

specs.label: Color Profile
specs.value: Deep Glossy Red Rind with Ruby Arils

specs.label: Packaging
specs.value: 3.5 kg / 4 kg Tray Pack (9 / 10 / 12 / 14 counts), as per your requirement

onion.name: Fresh Red & White Onions
onion.subtitle: Nashik Harvested • Golden-Red Flakes • Long Ambient Shelf Life
onion.description: Sourced from the mineral-dense soils of Nashik, our fresh onions boast firm, solid globes shielded by multiple intact, papery crimson skins that lock in pungent aroma and moisture. Dried thoroughly in specialized curing sheds, they resist sprouting and moisture decay, ensuring supreme resilience across open-container and reefer maritime shipments to ports worldwide.

specs.label: Varieties
specs.value: Nashik Red Onion / Light Red / White Onion

specs.label: Pungency
specs.value: Strong Sharp Aroma & High Dry Matter

specs.label: Packaging
specs.value: 10 kg / 20 kg / 25 kg / 50 kg Red Lenomesh Bag

turmeric.name: High-Curcumin Pure Turmeric
turmeric.subtitle: Salem & Nizamabad Finger • Golden Glow • Therapeutic Curcumin
turmeric.description: Revered across culinary and nutraceutical industries, our Indian turmeric fingers and whole dried rhizomes offer deep saffron-gold pigmentation and naturally elevated curcumin concentrations (up to 7%). Cured by ancient boiling and sun-basking traditions before mechanical polishing, our turmeric delivers unmatched earthy warmth, antibacterial potency, and pure export grade consistency.

specs.label: Types Available
specs.value: Single Polished Fingers, also Double Polished Fingers, Bulbs & Powder

specs.label: Packaging
specs.value: 25 kg / 50 kg Jute Bag or Poly-Lined PP Bags

aboutPage.intro: Connecting India's agricultural strength with global markets.
story: At Vishvasetu Exim, we believe that every successful global partnership begins with quality products, trusted relationships and a commitment to doing business the right way.

Based in India, we focus on sourcing fresh agricultural produce and connecting it with international buyers through a reliable, transparent and customer-focused export approach. From the farms where our products are grown to the markets where they are delivered, we aim to make every step of the journey more dependable.

Our product portfolio includes fresh G9 green bananas, G4 green chillies, pomegranates, onions and other agricultural commodities. We work towards meeting buyer specifications through careful sourcing, appropriate packaging, quality checks and coordinated shipment planning.

Behind every product are the farmers whose hard work brings India's agricultural richness to the world. We value these relationships and aim to build long-term partnerships that create value for farmers, buyers and our business alike.
Our promise is simple: to build trust through transparency, focus on quality at every stage, and develop lasting relationships with customers across global markets.
